## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle auxiliary notes-collection accompanying [寂光](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AF%82%E5%85%89)'s *Fànwǎngjīng zhíjiě* ([KR6k0100](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0100)). 事義 *shìyì* "factual meaning" indicates the genre — supplementary lexical and historical clarifications.

**Abstract**

The text supplies the auxiliary apparatus for Jìguāng's principal *Zhíjiě* commentary, providing definitions, identifications, and brief explanations for the technical terms and historical references in the parent text. Together with [KR6k0100](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0100) it forms the complete Bǎohuáshān commentary on the *Fànwǎng jīng*.
